item.text:
Audited the Roman transliteration against all 48 Urdu verse lines. Removed the unmatched opening refrain and duplicate number prefixes, moved the stanza about the children falling from camels to match the Urdu order, and corrected phonetic spellings and wording.

The Urdu body and metadata were preserved. The Urdu body has only two stanza numbers and places `ہے` at the start of a refrain line. The Roman retains its stanza grouping and follows that physical line break. Human editorial sign-off is pending.
